title: Function usage examples
responsibility: Shows authored function calls beside compact expected results and highlights changes from the first example.

inputs.name: UsageExamples.examples
inputs.description: Committed invocation code and expected JSON results or errors; the first example is the comparison baseline.

inputs.name: UsageExamples.setup
inputs.description: Optional shared setup displayed as escaped code without executing it.

outputs.name: UsageExamples
outputs.description: Responsive call/result rows with explicit output differences and truthful gaps for missing calls.
